crossRefs.note: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his…
But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about…

translations.web: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
translations.bsb: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.
translations.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
translations.asv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, And have not the understanding of a man;
